body.html: Nornlamphun Boutique Hotel sits at 99/2 Charoen Rat Road in the Mueang Nga area of Mueang Lamphun, about 2–3 km from the town centre · Lamphun is a compact little town, so that distance is just a few minutes by car or motorbike into the centre · What many guests like is that it's about 3.3 km from Wat Phra That Hariphunchai and only around 3 minutes from Lamphun railway station — handy if you arrive on the northern train line · Driving into Chiang Mai along the scenic Saraphi tree-lined road takes about 15–20 minutes, making Lamphun a good base for exploring both towns.

The hotel opened around 2019 as a small boutique of about 15 rooms, designed in a modern-loft style mixed with local simplicity · The lobby is open-air with high ceilings, airy and easy on the eye, while the rooms have parquet floors and feel more spacious than you'd expect at this price · Rooms come with air-conditioning, a fridge, a flat-screen TV, a work desk, free Wi-Fi and a walk-in shower with hot water · There are both double-bed and twin-bed rooms · Real guest reviews regularly note the room size and the minimal loft styling in a positive light.
"Really big, clean room with lovely loft decor, comfy bed and pillows, and friendly owners. Great location not far from Lamphun downtown, and only half an hour to drive into Chiang Mai."

The overall mood is calm and simple — well suited to a stopover or an overnight on the way north · There's a garden and a lounge corner to sit in, with a fireplace nook at times · Free private parking is easy to use, good for self-drivers · One thing that sets it apart from most stays is that it's pet-friendly (there may be an extra charge) — options for travelling north with a dog or cat are rare, so this is a hard-to-find pick · The hotel has no pool and isn't built around resort-style facilities; it leans on big, clean rooms and a quiet atmosphere instead.

On scores, the hotel earns consistent praise for cleanliness and room size · Agoda rates it around 9.0 (from a still-modest number of reviews), while Tripadvisor sits around 4.5 out of 5, and real guest sentiment across platforms leans the same way: good value · The areas it scores highest are cleanliness, the decor and the warm, friendly welcome from the owners · Overall it's a small boutique that delivers rooms bigger than its price in Lamphun.

A few things to know before you book · Some reviews mention that on certain nights there's noise from other guests or music running until around 23:00, so light sleepers should be ready or ask about a quieter room at booking · Breakfast here isn't a full buffet — it's more of a tea-and-coffee corner, and a few reviews note the options are limited and morning coffee hours are short · There aren't many restaurants right around the hotel, so most meals mean a drive into town · And as a property that's been open a few years, bedding in some rooms can look a little used — anyone expecting brand-new fittings should set expectations to the price point.

In short, Nornlamphun Boutique Hotel suits travellers after big, clean, nicely styled loft rooms in the ฿900-ish range, with a location near Lamphun's town centre that's also easy for driving into Chiang Mai · If you're self-driving, bringing a pet, or using Lamphun as a two-town base, it fits well · But if you want a stay within walking distance of the temple, a full breakfast, or guaranteed silence every night, it's worth comparing with Old Town options too.

A tip from following the reviews here closely: if you're a light sleeper, ask for an interior room or one further from the lobby at booking · If you're bringing a pet, let the hotel know in advance to check the conditions and any extra charge · During festivals and merit-making events at Wat Phra That Hariphunchai, rooms fill quickly, so book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Nornlamphun Boutique Hotel Lamphun

faq.q: Where is Nornlamphun Boutique Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 99/2 Charoen Rat Road in the Mueang Nga area of Mueang Lamphun, about 2–3 km from the town centre · It's only around 3 minutes from Lamphun railway station and about 3.3 km from Wat Phra That Hariphunchai · Driving into Chiang Mai city via the Saraphi road takes about 15–20 minutes, and Chiang Mai Airport is about 19 km away.

faq.q: How much does Nornlamphun Boutique Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start from approx ฿900/night for a Standard room (large bed or twin beds) · There's a more spacious Deluxe around ฿1,200 · All rooms have parquet floors, air-conditioning, a fridge, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi · Prices shift with season and festivals, so compare a few platforms before booking.
Yes, it accepts pets — a hard-to-find option in Lamphun · There may be an extra charge and some conditions, so it's best to tell the hotel in advance when booking to confirm the details.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Nornlamphun like?
faq.a: Rooms are styled in a modern-loft look with parquet floors and more space than you'd expect at this price · Real guest reviews often praise the cleanliness and decor · The lobby is open-air with high ceilings, plus a garden and lounge corner · There's no pool — the focus is on big, clean rooms and a quiet atmosphere.

faq.q: Who is Nornlamphun Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a strong pick for self-drivers, travellers bringing a pet, or anyone using Lamphun as a two-town base for Lamphun and Chiang Mai who want big, clean, nicely styled rooms in the ฿900-ish range · It's less ideal for those who want to walk to the temple, a full breakfast spread, or guaranteed silence every night.

faq.q: Are the rooms noisy, and is there breakfast?
faq.a: Some reviews note that on certain nights there's noise from guests or music until late, so light sleepers should ask for an interior room and pack earplugs · Breakfast is a tea-and-coffee corner rather than a full buffet, and morning coffee hours can be short · There aren't many restaurants around the hotel, so it's easier to drive into town for meals.
